title: GLB lib
description: A library mod that allows for glb 3d models to be used for minecraft entities
body:
GLB lib allows for real 3d models in the format of a .glb to be used for minecraft entities. Aswell as this it allows for glb animations to be used for entities in game by directly detecting them. GLB lib is needed as a dependency for any mod that should use its features. It does not provide content by itself, it is purely used to provide the architecture for other mods to build upon.
A small Test / Prove of Concept Mod I made with GLB lib is attached here:
https://modrinth.com/mod/glb-lib-test-mod
Please feel free to join the discord server linked for any questions or suggestions!
